page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

This instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Given the high memory density of 8.0 GB per core and dedicated physical compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that require predictable CPU performance. The lack of local storage requires architectural planning for external storage dependencies. It is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
